UserLocationProfile.title: UserLocationProfile
UserLocationProfile.description: Private per-user Good Chat profile and live location sharing preferences.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown on live location markers.

photoUrl.description: Optional profile avatar URL from Firebase Auth.

locationSharingEnabled.description: Master switch allowing live location sharing.

defaultDurationMinutes.description: Preferred default sharing window in minutes (15m, 1h, or 8h).

highAccuracyGps.description: Whether browser/device high-accuracy GPS is requested.

backgroundConsentGranted.description: Explicit user consent for background location updates.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last settings update.

LiveLocationShare.title: LiveLocationShare
LiveLocationShare.description: Real-time GPS location sharing session scoped to explicit consenting viewers.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user sharing their GPS location.

ownerName.description: Display name of the sharing user.

ownerPhotoUrl.description: Profile photo URL of the sharing user.

chatKey.description: Identifier of the Good Chat conversation where sharing started.

chatName.description: Name of the Good Chat conversation.

latitude.description: GPS latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.description: GPS longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

heading.description: Device heading in degrees (0-360, or -1 if unavailable).

durationMinutes.description: Chosen live sharing window (15, 60, or 480 minutes).

active.description: True while live GPS updates are streaming; false once stopped.

consentGranted.description: Explicit owner consent acknowledgement (must be true on create).

allowedViewerEmails.description: Bounded list (max 10) of verified contact emails authorized to view this live location.

expiresAtMs.description: Unix epoch millisecond timestamp when the live share expires.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when live sharing began.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest GPS coordinate update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and live location sharing settings readable and writable strictly by the authenticated owner.

/locationShares/{shareId}.description: Real-time live GPS sharing sessions readable only by the owner and explicitly authorized verified contact emails.
